character: Europe's highest ski resort at 2,300m. Purpose-built, fully pedestrianised, ski-in/ski-out from every accommodation block. 60+ restaurants, 40+ bars, 2 nightclubs. The functional 1970s architecture is softened by recent luxury additions (Hotel Le Coucou, Hotel Pashmina, Altapura). Galerie Caron houses the main shops.
architecture: Purpose-built 1970s with recent luxury renovations (Le Coucou, Pashmina, Altapura)
dining: 60+ restaurants including Chez Pépé Nicolas (Savoyard), La Pause de Pierrette (fresh produce terrace), Le Caron 3200 (summit wine bar at 3,200m), L'Alpin (traditional mountain), La Fruitière (self-service), Le Monde (bar-restaurant). Book ahead for Friday evenings.
shopping: Galerie Caron — supermarket, bakery, pharmacy, sports equipment rental, ski shops, fashion boutiques, souvenir shops, tobacco, optician, laundry, hair salon, concierge, luggage storage
apres_scene: La Folie Douce (iconic slope-side), Bar 360, Malaysia Club (nightclub), Café Face, Le Tonic, Le Monde. 40+ total bars. Nightclubs: Malaysia Club, Live Club.
activities_nearby: Ice skating rink, indoor swimming pool, double zip line, 6km toboggan run from Peclet gondola, bowling, cinema, fitness centre, squash courts, paintball, paragliding, dog sledding, snowmobiling, ice climbing, La Folie Douce apres, Caron 3200 wine bar
practical_info: Ski-in/ski-out throughout. Free resort shuttles. Medical centre (04 79 00 08 08). ESF + ESI ski schools. Ski rental from €20/day. Underground parking (paid). Galerie Caron ice rink. 60+ restaurants.
